src/agent_runtime/current_run/init.py

Python · Tier A

Current Agent UI run reconnect ledger.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/activity_watchdogs.py

Python · Tier A

Own retained per-job observation schedules and health/attention evidence across RAM and standalone SQLite stores. Registration, token claims, compare-and-merge publication and incident acknowledgement coordinate the external activity_watchdog worker. Completion probes and health sampling have independent clocks, while exact physical proof controls settlement. The retained runtime docstring below describes the standalone SQL schema; hub-backed WatchdogStore instances use memory_watchdogs and share the evidence merge rules.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
attention_current 102 Reject stale and legacy silence alarms before either backend dispatches.
incident_update 117 Track attention episodes separately by reason and physical-process identity, migrating the legacy single-incident shape in place. Confirm recovery only from successful supporting evidence; unknown/error observations do not clear an incident. Apply recurrence cooldowns and return whether a new delivery should be emitted, leaving the caller to advance its generation.
schema 188 Initialize the standalone SQLite watcher and prepared-policy tables, claim metadata and due-time indexes. Apply two idempotent migrations that freeze defaults for older prepared requests and split completion from health clocks. The live RAM backend uses its registered schema and MemoryWatchdogStore recovery instead.
read_in 267 Return a detached watchdog payload for the exact run/job pair from RAM Records or SQLite, or None if absent. Optionally report whether its token is unexpired using wall time; this read neither claims the watcher nor proves the observing process is alive.
write_in 304 Validate the observation phase and update an existing watcher in the caller transaction. Derive next_due_at from independent clocks while retaining next_observation_at as the legacy health deadline. Mutates those derived fields on the supplied record; invalid phases raise ValueError and no new identity is inserted.
register_in 346 Create or repair observation for a retained job without relaunching it. Bind the accepted run policy and Activity identity, distinguish attached, background, detached and cancellation phases, and reset failure backoff only for a material launch acknowledgement. Return None for already- complete jobs, missing owners or external waits; preserve existing observation fences.
terminal_in 559 Disable observation only when job evidence satisfies observation_complete, clearing both clocks and pending attention while retaining final bounded facts. A merely displayed failure or cancellation with unresolved physical ownership does not retire its watcher.
cancel_in 585 Stop acceptance schedules confirmation immediately in the same transaction.
snapshot_in 624 Project at most 32 enabled background health records for UI presentation, prioritizing pending attention and then health deadline. Omit attached-only/health-disabled watchers and expose allowlisted health fields, labels and freshness without claim tokens. RAM Records delegate to the equivalent memory projection.
WatchdogStore 663 Select the RAM watchdog owner for hub-backed stores and otherwise implement standalone SQLite scheduling/claims. Shared apply logic merges independently obtained physical evidence, while due/claim/release coordinate observers. No method here performs Gateway I/O or acquires parent Agent progression ownership.
WatchdogStore.get 677 Read one exact watcher payload without claiming or refreshing its physical evidence. A missing run/job pair returns None; the RAM subclass supplies its own record-view implementation.
WatchdogStore.due 685 List enabled standalone watchers whose combined deadline and claim expiry have elapsed, ordered by deadline/run/Activity and bounded by the supplied SQL limit. completion_only additionally requires the completion clock to be due. Listing is not a reservation; claim rechecks eligibility atomically.
WatchdogStore.deadline 708 Return the earliest effective wake time across enabled watchers, considering both the next due time and outstanding claim expiry. Return None when none remain; this read does not schedule a thread or probe a job.
WatchdogStore.claim 720 Atomically reserve an enabled standalone watcher for 120 seconds with a fresh token and process-instance metadata. Require an expired prior claim and elapsed failure backoff; force bypasses only the ordinary due-time check. Return None on contention or ineligibility, otherwise the token needed for publication/release.
WatchdogStore.reserve_confirmation 755 Spend the persisted inspection allowance before contacting a stopped job.
WatchdogStore.rearm_confirmation 788 An explicit inspection or new authenticated connection reopens one episode.
WatchdogStore.acknowledge_confirmation_notice 835 Retire a delivered receipt notice without scheduling any transport work.
WatchdogStore.for_activity 863 Resolve ownership without the presentation snapshot's size limit.
WatchdogStore.unavailable_confirmation 878 A missing local ownership row remains unknown; consume this inspection.
WatchdogStore.release 907 Clear only the matching observation token. When local persistence failed, retry=True delays both claim availability and due processing by at least 0.25 seconds. This retry does not classify a remote failure, release physical resource ownership or overwrite a newer observer claim.
WatchdogStore.activate_background 922 Transfer the same job to the due worker without resetting progress or claims.
WatchdogStore.retire 945 Deleted execution ownership cannot leave a permanently overdue watcher.
WatchdogStore.recover 961 Repair standalone observation metadata in one low-frequency transaction. Clear dead process- instance claims, register unfinished retained jobs, retire missing/tombstoned/completed owners and transfer dead attached observers to background. Spread overdue background deadlines by a stable 0–250 ms offset without probing or relaunching physical work.
WatchdogStore.apply 1046 Merge an externally obtained sample inside the owning RAM transaction or a standalone immediate SQL transaction, then notify scheduling consumers after commit when state changed or attention/terminal evidence warrants it. Return merge details or None for rejected evidence; remote I/O must already have completed outside this transaction.
WatchdogStore._apply_in 1097 Validate retained ownership and an optional exact claim token, reject stale/miscorrelated samples, and preserve stronger terminal/progress evidence. Publish proven physical settlement atomically before advancing completion retry clocks and optional health classification. Health samples may create one generation-tagged attention slot and bounded redacted output; observation errors keep physical uncertainty intact. Return record/job/transition/wake details, or None when evidence is no longer applicable.
attention_selected 1547 Detached work only interrupts the agent when it explicitly waits for that work.
attention 1567 Read current pending evidence, revalidating terminal/progress/Stop precedence.
envelope 1631 The whole batch, including UTF-8 JSON overhead, is bounded below 12 KiB.
consume_in 1698 Acknowledge only the delivered incident ID, or the matching legacy generation/reason pair, inside the caller transaction. Ignore missing, superseded or already-delivered incidents, advance the log offset monotonically and clear pending attention only for the current reason. This does not acknowledge the separate terminal-completion mailbox.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/completion_mailbox.py

Python · Tier A

Deliver ordered Activity completions to an owned Agent decision without losing or double- consuming a batch. The public helpers dispatch RAM Records and hub-backed stores to memory_mailbox; the SQL implementation supports standalone stores. Event append, stable delivery identity and exact cursor acknowledgement are distinct operations. The historical SQLite wording in the retained runtime docstring below describes only that backend.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
schema 31 Create the standalone SQLite event log, deduplication index and delivery cursor tables. Call during schema initialization; transaction ownership stays with the caller. The live RAM store uses its registered record schemas instead.
append_in 55 Record a terminal Activity result reference once per run, Activity, reference and terminal-state identity, returning its ordered sequence. Repeated delivery returns the original sequence and increments diagnostics. Use the caller's transaction; Records inputs delegate to the RAM mailbox.
import_legacy_in 101 One-time lazy import, preserving consumed sequence and historical outcomes.
project_in 138 Replace the caller's mailbox view with cursor metadata and at most limit undelivered events, ordered by sequence, plus the existing delivery identity. Missing cursor rows leave the supplied state untouched. This read does not acknowledge results; Records inputs use the RAM projection.
prepare 175 Validate progression ownership and select or replay a stable completion batch before a model decision. SQLite cursor preparation commits before receipt presentation; each receipt is bounded to 2400 characters, with missing or invalid references presented as unavailable. RAM stores delegate to their transaction-aware draft implementation.
consume_in 223 Acknowledge only the exact in-flight delivery ID carried by a nonempty accepted batch, after validating the run lease. Refresh the supplied state from the cursor and clear its transient updates. The caller must commit this together with its accepted decision; Records inputs delegate to the RAM mailbox.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/execution_observation.py

Python · Tier A

Explain retained execution state to status APIs without executing or recovering work. ExecutionObservation.inspect resolves scoped identities and combines native, scheduler, receipt, trace and watchdog facts; progress_facts classifies freshness and presentation prepares UI labels. Missing, ambiguous and malformed locators remain distinct failures. Admission does not prove process liveness, and unknown progress is preserved instead of invented.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
epoch 147 Accept numeric timestamps unchanged or parse nonempty ISO timestamps, including a trailing Z. Return None for absent or unparsable text caught as TypeError/ValueError. This conversion helper does not itself validate numeric finiteness or timestamp freshness.
progress_facts 160 Classify retained progress independently of admission: recent evidence within 30 seconds is progressing; older evidence is idle only with a declared producer metric contract. A running liveness observation is fresh for 120 seconds. Return progress facts and a separate alive flag; a single inspection never proves stagnation.
presentation 242 Translate an observation into compact UI labels, wait/progress details and identifiers. Run-level terminal or human-checkpoint status takes precedence, and a completed child alone does not complete a running task. Add recovery guidance and a bounded Shell output preview only for the matching waiting job; no storage or process control occurs.
ObservationNotFound 375 Signal that retained execution evidence is absent, tombstoned or inconsistent with a supplied conversation/task/operation scope. Callers can distinguish this lookup failure from ambiguous identities and malformed input.
AmbiguousObservation 382 Require a more specific locator when multiple retained runs match and a unique active candidate cannot be selected. This protects observation from silently attaching another execution to the requested UI context.
ExecutionObservation 390 Assemble read-only execution evidence from a native store plus optional task and trace stores. The injected clock makes freshness deterministic. Scheduler admission, physical liveness, semantic checkpoints and retained progress remain separate facts; inspection neither dispatches work nor repairs it.
ExecutionObservation.inspect 402 Validate locators, resolve task/conversation scope and select retained native evidence through RAM or query-only SQLite reads. Return a redacted version-1 observation combining job receipts, scheduler admission, watchdog health, trace progress and task-context delivery diagnostics. Missing and ambiguous identities raise distinct errors; invalid locators raise ValueError. Observation capacity may wait, and supplemental reads are not one cross-store transaction. No Gateway probe, inference call or execution mutation is performed.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/job_observation.py

Python · Tier A

Read an existing job and terminal receipt without recovery or Gateway access.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
observation_complete 10 A terminal label retires observation only after physical ownership ended.
retain_terminal_evidence 20 Terminal outcome is monotone; later physical-death evidence can advance it. A logical cancellation may precede confirmed process exit. Keeping every old field forever would strand its physical claim. Only a non-stale observation of the same job/enrollment may confirm release; it cannot change the outcome, receipt or make a late running acknowledgement reacquire ownership.
retain_progress_evidence 101 Writer-side evidence retention; a status heartbeat is not progress. Use the producer's timestamp only when its retained material grew. Observation GETs never call this helper or update the record.
retained_job 165 Take one read-only, request-scoped snapshot; never follow inherited artifacts. The observer must not initialize a store, repair a run, or inspect a remote job. A missing database (including lightweight trace-only deployments) has no receipt.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/journal_scope.py

Python · Tier A

Keep native transcript ownership separate from the visible chat identity. Scope resolution and durable journal bindings let independent tasks share a chat without borrowing each other's execution evidence; read paths require explicit lineage, and retention enumerates only recorded ownership.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
scope 17 Resolve transcript conversation scope and agent mode from a run's saved lineage and resume context. Reference-only runs use the continuation root rather than borrowing a visible conversation; ordinary runs prefer explicit conversation identities before falling back to the root or run.
initialize 36 Create the authoritative journal ownership index.
resolve_native_journal_id 47 Bind a lineage in the caller's transaction, or recover its exact binding. Only begin_conversation and create_continuation select an inherited journal. Unbound independent requests default to their durable execution identity. Reads require an existing binding and never infer ownership.
owned_journals 113 Return the distinct journal identities explicitly bound to a conversation through RAM Records or a caller-selected SQLite schema. The schema argument is internal SQL structure, not a user- supplied identifier; this lookup never infers ownership from message content.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/lifecycle_projection.py

Python · Tier A

Translate checkpoint, Activity, job and resource-queue facts into UI lifecycle phases and allowed actions. read_work gathers a consistent backend view, work_facts reconciles physical identities, and project separates semantic outcome from physical settlement. repair_legacy is the explicit exceptional path: it mutates a supplied checkpoint only for proven historical owner-contention partials, leaving persistence to its caller.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
all_activities 37 One execution identity across foreground, DAG and background projections.
physical_state 57 Outcome uncertainty can outlive physical ownership.
work_facts 72 @brief Combine required Activity/job/queue physical states while excluding detached work and retaining unresolved/resource-wait counts.
activity_facts 157 Calculate work counts from the Activities and completion cursor already present in a checkpoint. This convenience path has no separate job or resource-queue snapshot; callers with those facts should use read_work or pass work to project.
read_work 161 One read-only snapshot; status reads never release a claim or poll a target.
project 278 Combine checkpoint status, progression ownership, scheduled work and physical-work facts into UI phases, labels and action eligibility. Semantic completion can coexist with unresolved physical work; settlement gates retry, restart and continuation. Optional eligibility only restricts computed actions. Returns a new projection without dispatch, persistence, Gateway polling or model calls.
repair_legacy 433 Reopen only a historical partial checkpoint with an explicit owner-contention error and known required background jobs. Stop, pause, accepted completion, continuations and uncertain outcomes prevent repair. Mutate the supplied state to waiting_job and retain a bounded repair event; the caller owns persistence.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_agent_turns.py

Python · Tier A

Manage model-turn capacity leases and execution-phase projections in the Controller's RAM authority. MemoryAgentTurns adapts the shared AgentTurns admission rules, cancellation checks and wake notifications; transaction callbacks own lease changes, while provider execution occurs in the caller's leased block.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
phase 31 Write a request's execution-phase projection into the caller's RAM transaction, recording the associated run, wall time and current process identity. This records scheduling state; it does not start a model request.
checkpoint 48 Derive a phase from a saved run and return whether its request projection changed. Preserve an existing phase when the checkpoint has no phase classification, and seed an unseen request as ready_agent_turn.
MemoryAgentTurns 61 Implement AgentTurns against the Controller's shared RAM repository. Admission, phase changes and counters commit atomically; inherited entry points retain cancellation, ownership and nested- lease handling.
MemoryAgentTurns.recover 65 Leave recovery to the unique hub bootstrap, which already invalidates leases from the previous Controller generation. Calling this adapter must not revoke current reservations again.
MemoryAgentTurns._lease 74 Queue a reservation and wait for shared admission under caller capacity, endpoint capacity and blocked-endpoint constraints. Check cancellation while waiting, bind the acquired lease to this thread's context, and release it in finally while updating wait/active metrics and waking contenders. Optional phase projection does not change admission authority.
MemoryAgentTurns.snapshot 202 Read leases, requested phase projections and copied metrics from one RAM view. Return active/waiting counts and active request identities; request_ids filters phases only, so aggregate counts remain Controller-wide.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_artifact_metadata.py

Python · Tier A

Maintain the metadata-only artifact discovery index as native results, aliases and run scopes change. NativeRecords invokes the projection hooks inside its transaction; list_artifacts reads a coherent conversation view and returns bounded public metadata without loading result bodies.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
scope 18 Choose the artifact discovery conversation from the run or resume context, falling back to the run identity, and pair it with the run's creation time for stable ordering.
project 31 Replace one run/reference/source discovery entry using the saved artifact and its creation sequence. Remove stale entries when any required row is absent; retain only normalized status, capability and bounded field names, ordered by newest run and artifact, so listing never needs the result body.
changed 81 Maintain discovery entries inside the transaction that changes an artifact, alias or run scope. Allocate artifact order on first insertion, update aliases of changed source results, and remove old alias entries before a source switch.
rebuild 121 Repopulate artifact and alias discovery projections from retained RAM records during bootstrap. Reuse project so recovered listings follow the same metadata filtering and order as live writes.
discover 134 Return at most 50 matching metadata rows from a coherent native/conversation snapshot, requiring both repositories to share a hub. Reject oversized queries or invalid limits; skip missing chats, absent source runs, missing/mismatched journal ownership and tombstoned owners. The ownership check matches the context-link endpoint; historical reference-only scopes are not reusable. ASCII-only substring matching covers references, capability IDs and field names, never field values or artifact bodies.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_capability_events.py

Python · Tier A

Keep capability outbox events in stable per-run sequence order in RAM. NativeRecords updates the index with each event mutation; consumers page detached payloads after their last cursor, while delivery acknowledgement remains outside this module.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
changed 14 Maintain the per-run capability-event order alongside an outbox insertion or deletion. Allocate a sequence only for a new event identity; payload updates retain their position, while deletion removes both cursor and order record.
page 35 Return detached capability-event payloads with sequence cursors strictly after the caller's cursor in one RAM view. This accessor has no explicit result limit; delivery acknowledgement and cursor advancement belong to its caller.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_context_metadata.py

Python · Tier A

Index attachment sources, enforce conversation grants and produce bounded context-discovery metadata. NativeRecords owns transactional index updates; ContextStore owns the immutable body files. Discovery and grant reads exclude tombstoned owners and do not read attachment content.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
changed 16 Add or remove an attachment identity in the context discovery index with its source row. Allocate a creation sequence once and retain it through metadata updates, keeping content bytes outside the index.
rebuild 32 Restore attachment discovery ordering from retained context-source records during bootstrap, reusing each saved sequence when available.
bind_in 40 Grant a conversation access to an existing context source in the caller's transaction and return copied metadata. Reject tombstoned conversations, missing sources and cross-conversation reuse unless retained_reusable permits it; an existing grant to the same conversation remains valid.
metadata_in 63 Return copied context metadata only when the conversation has an explicit grant and is not tombstoned. Return None for denied or missing sources without opening their body files.
discover 76 Search bounded attachment metadata across retained, non-tombstoned conversation grants using one shared hub snapshot. Visit newest sources first and match ASCII-folded identity/name/type fields. Reject invalid query bounds or mixed authorities; check body-file existence after applying the result limit, so missing files can leave a short page.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_continuation.py

Python · Tier A

Maintain coalesced run readiness, dependency subscriptions and process-local deadlines in the native RAM authority. Transaction helpers retain timer and Stop expiration facts and expose bounded work batches; MemoryContinuationWorker performs reconciliation and resume decisions outside those transactions.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
timer_identity 27 Build the stable event identity for one time wait from its wake time, creation time and generation. The same saved wait must deduplicate after recovery; a replacement wait gets a different identity.
timer_fired 36 Check the hashed run/timer wake-event identity in the current transaction and require its retained payload to be a time event. A committed expiration remains true even if the wall clock later moves backwards.
changed 45 Maintain ready-work and monotonic-deadline ordered indexes with their record mutations. Remove each prior key before inserting the replacement so changed deadlines cannot leave duplicate scheduler entries.
signal 67 Coalesce a retained runnable or unfinished run into the ready queue, preserving its first enqueue time and advancing its generation. Suppress self-notification during processing unless forced; for a current owner retain a deferred wake instead, except when committed Stop still needs work. Missing and tombstoned runs are ignored.
dependency 102 Advance the revision of a named dependency and signal only runs indexed as waiting on it. The revision lets a worker detect capacity changes that race its subscription without scanning all saved runs.
wait_capacity 112 Close the race between a failed capacity check and its subscription. If the capacity revision changed, force a new readiness notification; otherwise install the run's capacity watch in the same transaction.
watch 122 Register an idempotent run/kind/dependency wait record using a string identity. The dependency index supports targeted wakeup when that resource changes.
schedule 133 Translate a wall deadline once into this process's monotonic clock and store it by run and kind. An unchanged wall deadline retains its original translation; overdue deadlines become immediately eligible instead of acquiring a new delay.
refresh 154 Reconcile one retained run's monitor/schedule subscriptions, time/resource/Stop deadlines and ready-work entry with current source state. Preserve worker-owned capacity watches and outstanding probe retries, suppress queued progression while an owner is active, and release deferred wakes when ownership ends. Deletion removes derived work rather than reviving a run.
recover 234 Discard prior-process readiness, wait and monotonic-deadline records, then rebuild them once from retained native runs during bootstrap. Recovery restores scheduler metadata; it does not dispatch saved operation intentions.
take 252 Atomically expire a bounded set of due deadlines and dequeue up to limit ready runs, excluding workers already in flight. Retain matching timer/Stop expiration facts before signaling; return run/generation pairs. Emit optional timing diagnostics only after publication and ignore observer failures so they cannot lose accepted work.
retry_orphans 334 Schedule per-run backoff only while orphaned foreground resource claims lack a corresponding job. Increase the remembered attempt to a bounded exponent and delay 2 through 60 seconds; ignore tombstoned runs and leave physical reconciliation to the worker.
delay 357 Return zero for eligible queued work, seconds until the earliest eligible monotonic deadline, or None when no wake is found. Inspect bounded index windows that account for excluded in-flight runs; this calculates a condition-wait timeout without polling history.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_conversation_references.py

Python · Tier A

Maintain a derived conversation-to-run index in the same transaction as each checkpoint mutation. Deletion and management readers use these memberships to find affected execution identities without scanning full run state.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
index_run 13 Move a run's membership from its old conversation scope to its new scope inside the saving transaction. Resolve scope from run state, resume context or the run identity so deletion can find owned runs without scanning checkpoint bodies.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_execution_observation.py

Python · Tier A

Resolve execution locators against derived indexes in one immutable native snapshot. The reader intersects caller scopes, rejects missing or ambiguous ownership and returns allowlisted state/activity/job/receipt facts for ExecutionObservation; it neither probes a Gateway nor advances a run.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
activities 30 Collect activity records from batches, dependency activities and background activities, keyed by identity. Later sources replace duplicate keys so observation uses the same merged activity view for indexing and presentation.
project 45 Copy only named fields from a retained mapping, following dotted paths and returning None for missing or non-mapping components. Thaw selected values so the caller cannot mutate an immutable hub snapshot.
memberships 58 Derive nonempty conversation, task, activity and operation locator memberships from one native- run row. Include both explicit and resume-context conversations plus the foreground operation; these keys support scoped observation without a full run scan.
changed 84 Update locator memberships and live-before-terminal ordering alongside a run mutation. Remove old keys when scope or terminal rank changes, and insert only changed memberships into the derived observation indexes.
read 101 Resolve intersecting run/request/conversation/task/activity/operation selectors against one RAM snapshot, starting with the smallest locator set. Reject deleted, missing or ambiguous matches; prefer one live match over terminal history. Return allowlisted state/activity/job facts, a matching compact terminal receipt and retained watchdog data without journal replay, Gateway I/O or lease repair.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_gateway_references.py

Python · Tier A

Project live native runs and their Gateway dependencies for management and update admission. Hooks from NativeRecords account for jobs, continuations and tombstones, apply update guards and retain only small identity fields; Settings does not traverse model transcripts or tool payloads.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
refresh 20 Recompute one run's live management dependencies from status, unresolved interrupted operations, background jobs and continuation ownership. Remove inactive, tombstoned or superseded entries; apply Server and Gateway update-admission guards before publishing live identity metadata. Keep live runs with no Gateway dependency visible for Server draining.
changed 80 Refresh dependency projections for changed runs, jobs, continuation edges and deletion tombstones in their business transaction. Revisit predecessor runs when a successor changes, and use retained journal/reference indexes to locate runs affected by conversation deletion.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_ledger.py

Python · Tier A

Keep UI reconnect records, selection, status counts and ordered history in the existing native RAM domain. MemoryCurrentRunStore preserves standalone ledger semantics while using atomic projection updates and coherent joins to task/native state, rather than opening runtime SQLite connections.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
changed 32 Maintain status timelines, acknowledgement-partitioned counts and current-run fallback ranking in the ledger mutation's transaction. Unacknowledged active work ranks above pending work and terminal history; acknowledged rows remain available through explicit inclusive reads.
record 67 Convert a retained RAM row into AgentCurrentRunRecord with detached metadata, optionally selecting named metadata fields. Return None for a missing row; validation failures propagate rather than silently manufacturing a record.
MemoryCurrentRunStore 81 Keep UI reconnect records and the selected run in the native RAM authority. Serialize small ledger writes locally to reduce competing index rebuilds, while reads use immutable views and related task status joins require the same Controller hub.
MemoryCurrentRunStore.get_run 155 Return a detached validated ledger record for a normalized run identity, or None when the record is absent.
MemoryCurrentRunStore.get_run_by_request_id 160 Return the newest ledger record linked to the request as current, parent or root identity. This reconnect lookup does not grant an old request permission to update the active attempt.
MemoryCurrentRunStore.get_run_by_task_id 165 Return the newest ledger record associated with the normalized durable-task identity, or None when no indexed match exists.
MemoryCurrentRunStore.get_current_run 171 Return the selected or ranked fallback ledger record. summary_only retains just the prepared_request metadata field, avoiding materialization of the rest of the retained metadata.
MemoryCurrentRunStore.selected_run_id 178 Expose the explicit UI selection identity, returning an empty string when unset. Unlike get_current_run, this does not choose a ranked fallback.
MemoryCurrentRunStore.activate_run 192 Select an existing ledger run atomically and return its detached record. Leave the selection unchanged and return None when the requested identity is absent.
MemoryCurrentRunStore.list_runs 220 Return a paginated newest-first ledger listing with a clamped 1-to-500 page size. Read limit plus offset from the indexes and optionally expose only task/event title and identity metadata; execution records and transcripts are not replayed.
MemoryCurrentRunStore.counts 237 Read cached per-status ledger counts, optionally combining acknowledged rows. This uses projection counters instead of enumerating retained runs.
MemoryCurrentRunStore.set_current_run 249 Create or replace a reconnect record and optionally select it in one transaction. Without an explicit run ID, reuse a match by parent request, task or current request, in that order. Preserve original creation time, reset acknowledgement, bound displayed strings and detach JSON metadata so a continuation retains one UI identity.
MemoryCurrentRunStore._update 307 Patch an exact run, request match or current fallback while refusing an obsolete request ID. Acknowledgement applies only to terminal records; normalize supported fields, detach replacement metadata and update the timestamp only when a change set exists. Return the existing record unchanged when a fence rejects the patch.
MemoryCurrentRunStore.update_current_run 348 Apply a guarded reconnect-record patch in the serialized ledger transaction and return the resulting record. Request identity fences prevent an earlier attempt from overwriting its continuation's status.
MemoryCurrentRunStore.acknowledge_current_run 354 Mark an eligible terminal ledger record acknowledged using the same request/run fences as ordinary updates. Open work remains unacknowledged; this affects UI history selection, not execution completion.
MemoryCurrentRunStore.delete_run 371 Delete one normalized reconnect-ledger identity and prune a dangling selection atomically. Return whether a ledger row was removed; native run evidence is outside this operation.
MemoryCurrentRunStore.delete_runs 383 Delete matching ledger entries in newest-first order, honoring acknowledgement and optional count filters. By default a broad all-status cleanup preserves the explicitly selected open run; narrower status cleanup follows its requested filter. Prune a missing selection and return the deletion count.

MemoryCurrentRunStore.conversation_status_rows 428 Join requested conversation ledger rows with task and native-run status in one shared transaction. Require the configured task repository path to match this hub, resolve request aliases, and return small status/Stop fields; None selects all conversations, while an empty list selects none.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_mailbox.py

Python · Tier A

Deliver terminal activity events through a replayable per-run mailbox committed with receipt state. Append and import preserve sequence identity; prepare publishes a bounded delivery draft, and consume advances its exact cursor with the owning decision transaction.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
changed 21 Maintain a sequence window with the receipt's own publication.
append 36 Record a terminal activity notification in the receipt's RAM transaction and return its sequence. Deduplicate by run/activity/result-reference/terminal-state, including imported legacy events; allocate the next per-run cursor only for a new semantic completion.
import_legacy 81 Initialize mailbox cursors once from checkpointed background-event fields. Import only events after the delivered cursor, preserve their sequence positions and advance beyond the saved high- water mark so recovery does not redeliver acknowledged events.
project 114 Copy mailbox cursors and up to 64 undelivered event summaries into a state draft, preserving an existing in-flight delivery identity. This reads the supplied transaction and mutates the draft only; it does not acknowledge delivery.
prepare 151 Validate the progression lease and publish a private mailbox-field draft with a stable bounded delivery batch. Reuse an existing in-flight batch on replay; after commit, attach compact receipt facts to its events, representing missing results as unavailable. Failed transactional preparation leaves the live owner's containers untouched.
consume 199 Acknowledge an exact in-flight delivery only while the state's progression lease remains valid. Advance the delivered cursor in the caller's transaction when the delivery ID matches, clear local updates and reproject pending events; a stale batch cannot consume a newer delivery.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_policy.py

Python · Tier A

Capture prompt permission policy and amend a waiting run's grant in the same RAM authority as its checkpoint. The module delegates normalization and matching to permission_policy, checks exact pending-operation identity, and commits conversation policy changes atomically when that grant scope is requested.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
capture_prompt 14 Store the accepted normalized prompt policy at revision zero with its run transaction. For a nonempty policy, append a permission-audit entry and prune audit sequences older than the latest 1000; absent policy is recorded as an empty value without an audit event.
amend 42 Atomically apply a matching permission grant to an unowned run still waiting for the exact expected approval. Reject global/scoped-policy grants, changed pending operations and current denials. Conversation grants require the same hub and a retained chat; update that chat's policy revision together with the run's manual-approval policy, then save through control authority.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_receipt_metadata.py

Python · Tier A

Maintain stable receipt cursors and an index of unresolved Gateway transfers. NativeRecords updates both indexes with receipt changes; recovery callers receive copied candidates from bounded continuation ancestry and decide separately whether any physical reconciliation is safe.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
changed 16 Keep stable receipt order and the uncertain-transfer index synchronized with receipt writes. A transfer is eligible only with gateway_transfer arguments and no result, a running result or an outcome_unknown result; status changes remove resolved entries without reordering the receipt.
